negative_reviews.author: April Joy Aquino
negative_reviews.text:
Really disappointing experience compared to the Meadowhall branch. The food was good, but the service was extremely slow. We waited so long to order that I actually forgot what I wanted, despite several staff members walking past our table.

The starter arrived so late that I had already finished my ramen! 😅

No one seemed to be paying attention to our table, and we were close to leaving. At least they didn’t charge a service charge, which says a lot. Hopefully the Nottingham branch can improve the service because the food is good, but the experience was not.

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo Weekly Dash PDF overview (Sales Overview) — gap-site weekly sales; ops metrics not in this source. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers rose by 66 week on week (+4.22%) while spend per head fell by £2.32 (-10.82%).
Sales were down £1,984.56 week on week (-5.21%) but £2,799.08 ahead of target (+8.41%).
Labour, budget rota, operational F/R and food and drinks variance were left blank in the report.
Staff updates were blank, recruitment was reported as N/A, and no maintenance jobs were logged.
The site has moved to two JFC orders a week, agreed with O, to stop running out of meat and drinks every Sunday; this was the first Sunday without a stock out.
Friday stock ran short because not enough was defrosted and prepped.
Duplicate invoice uploads and a beef delivery logged that did not arrive overstated food cost; the food cost sheet has been corrected.
Staff meal spend on the staff tab needs checking against the number of staff working.
A food safety complaint on Deliveroo gave no details, and a gluten free request was not shown on the ticket; photos were submitted to reclaim both.
A one star review cited very slow service and a forgotten order.
A Saturday review from guests who shared a ramen was felt to be unfair, as service was good.
The Tonkotsu and Tori Paitan broths were tested on a visit and the Paitan was rated good; broth had been diluted during a period of restricted ordering, and normal practice has resumed.
Front of house has many new starters and is chaotic, expected to settle in one to two weeks.
The new AGM is not yet ready to run shifts alone and has had no bar training.
A further sushi chef is needed, pending agreement on the hours available, and a sushi team member returned this week.
Floor professional cleaning has been approved by Michael, and new lampshades are needed.
Upcoming trade drivers include the Pussycat Dolls concert, student night on Thursday and a Panthers game on Saturday.
The site asked for a Halloween decorations budget, which marketing must decide for all sites.
The Deliveroo and Slurp discount promotion with a scratch card and a can of Coke in every bag is due to start on 12/10.
